DILG BAGONG PILIPINAS Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT OG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph OILG OPINION NO. s. 204 JUL 09 2025 MS. JULIETA J. BEREDICO Barangay Secretary Barangay San Vicente Gorong-Gorong Municipality of Nabua Province of Camarines Sur Dear Ms. Beredico: This refers to your letter dated 28 August 2024 requesting this Department's opinion relative to your function as a Barangay Secretary. In your letter, you informed the Department of the following salient facts and circumstances: I. You have been serving as the Barangay Secretary of Barangay San Vicente Gorong-Gorong, Nabua, Camarines Sur, since 1998. 2. On October 30, 2023, your brother, Joel J. Beredico, was elected as Punong Barangay (PB) of Barangay San Vicente Gorong-Gorong. 3. On December 4, 2023, the Sangguniang Barangay passed and approved Resolution No. 02, s. 2023, titled "A Resolution Extending the Services of Ms. Julieta J. Beredico as Barangay Secretary of San Vicente Gorong-Gorong, Nabua, Camarines Sur". 4. In May 2024, you were not able to receive your mid-year bonus due to the advice of the Commission on Audit (COA) to your Barangay Treasurer to withhold the payment of said benefit. 5. On August 22, 2024, COA also cancelled the check for the payment of your honorarium. From the foregoing facts, you submitted the following issues which we hereby quote in toto: I. Does COA have the power or authority to withhold the midyear bonus and cancel the check intended for the payment of honorarium for barangay officials? 2. Does the rule on nepotism apply to your position as Barangay Secretary, being a non-career service and a confidential capacity position? "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline NO. (02) 8876 3454

On the fir-st-qu.e.r.Y, we are constrained to refrain from giving our opinion on the matter. By established policy 1 and precedents, this Department has refrained from acting on queries that are cognizable by other agencies of the government. Prudence dictates that the matter should be addressed to COA and seek clarification as to the reason for withholding your midyear bonus and honorarium. Indeed, COA has the authority to disallow expenditures that are deemed irregular, unnecessary, excessive, extravagant, illegal, and unconscionable pursuant to Section 2 (2), Article IX-D of the 1987 Constitution. With regard to the second issue, we answer in the affirmative. Please be apprised that the appointment and qualifications of the Barangay Secretary is governed by Republic Act No. 7160, or the "Local Government Code" (hereinafter referred to as the Code). In particular, Section 394 thereof, pertinently, provides that: "Section 394. Barangay Secretary: Appointment, Qualifications, Powers and Duties. - (c) No person shall be appointed barangay secretary if he is a sangguniang barangay member, a government employee, or a relative of the punong barangay within the fourth civil degree of consanguinity of affinity (Emphasis ours) It is clear from the ambit of Section 394 (c) that no person shall be appointed as barangay secretary if he/she is a relative of the punong barangay within the fourth civil degree of consanguinity or affinity. In the case at hand, a sister is a relative within the second degree of consanguinity; thüs, the prohibition applies. This Department is of the submission that while the position of Barangay Secretary is deemed non-career and confidential in nature, the same does not ipso facto exempt it from the rules on nepotism. Here, it bears noting that the duties and functions of the Barangay Secretary as set forth in Section 394 (d) of the Code2 are not akin to an executive assistant or such position, which would warrant the exemption from nepotism rules. 1 Memorandum Order No. 2010-02 2 (d) The barangay secretary shall: (I) Keep custody of all records of the sangguniang barangay and the barangay assembly meetings; (2) Prepare and keep the minutes of all meetings of the sangguniang barangay and the barangay assembly; (3) Prepare a list of members of the barangay assembly, and have the same posted in conspicuous places within the barangay; (4) Assist in the preparation of all necessary forms for the conduct of barangay elections, initiatives, referenda or plebiscites, in coordination with the COMELEC; (5) Assist the municipal civil registrar in the registration of births, deaths, and marriages; (6) Keep an updated record of all inhabitants of the barangay containing the following items of information: name, address. place and date of birth. sex. civil status, citizenship, occupation, and such other items of information as may be prescribed by law or ordinance; (7) Submit a report on the actual number of barangay residents as often as may be required by the sangguniang barangay; and (8) Exercise such other powers and perform such other duties and functions as may be prescribed by law or ordinance. Page 2 of3

We hope the foregoing discussion sufficiently addressed your concerns. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to the decisions that competent higher authorities and the courts may subsequently decree. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO P. BENITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLNRPB/LLLS-LRALLD/jvpr0am Page 3 of 3
